purpose: Private append-only archive for source documents, source-linked facts, and deterministic Company Intelligence snapshots.
access_boundary: Archive tables have RLS enabled with no anon, authenticated, or public grants. Only the server-side sync credential may write. Browser research remains served from the existing private CI data slice.
sync_activation_requirement: Set HENNETH_CI_SUPABASE_URL and HENNETH_CI_SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY only in the cloud secret store, then run the deterministic archive adapter. Never store credentials in this receipt or repository.

formal_owner_assumptions.security: RLS is enabled with authenticated users limited to their own rows; the server-side importer additionally filters to HENNETH_CI_OWNER_USER_ID and uses approval date as the first eligible date.
formal_owner_assumptions.activation_requirement: Set HENNETH_CI_OWNER_USER_ID only in the cloud secret store, then add explicit approved, dated, source-labelled owner rows. Missing configuration or rows leaves formal engines blocked.
